sources.title: Affine (SN120) — Reasoning Model Competition | Bittensor.ai
sources.snippet: Register a Bittensor hotkey on Subnet 120, create a HuggingFace account with a write token, then pull a baseline model from the network with `af pull <UID>`. Improve it through training or fine-tuning, upload to HuggingFace in a repo named with your hotkey suffix, and run `af miner-deploy` to commit the model revision on-chain.

sources.title: GitHub - ysjprojects/affine-sn120: Anima Machina
sources.snippet: These models are evaluated on a set of RL-environments with validators looking for the model which dominates the pareto frontier -- namely the model which outcompetes all other models on all envs (see af validator) The network is winners-take-all where miners are forced to copy, download and improve the pareto frontier model. Why affine?
